title: Validation exceeds the spec (year range + ISBN format)
evidence: Book.cs:33-50 — BookValidator rejects year outside 1450..next-year and malformed ISBN-10/13, beyond the required title/author checks
suggestion: No action needed; noted as beyond-spec rigor

title: Health check verifies DB reachability, not just liveness
evidence: Program.cs:12-15 + BookRepository.cs:24-37 — /health runs SELECT 1 and returns 503 if the SQLite connection fails
suggestion: No action needed; stronger than a static 200

title: ?author= filter is case-insensitive exact match, not substring
suggestion: Spec only requires an author filter; exact match satisfies R3. Substring/LIKE would be a design choice, not a fix
